name: Cashingularity Parimutuel Prediction Pool
description: On-chain Parimutuel Prediction Market covenant migrating PredictionPool.cash to XO Stack with CashTokens NFT Receipts, Oracle Resolution, and Timeout Refunds.

resources.name: Baseline PredictionPool.cash Contract
resources.description: Original CashScript P2SH32 parimutuel prediction pool covenant migrated top-to-bottom into this XOTemplate.

predictor.name: Predictor
predictor.description: Stakes BCH into a market outcome bucket, receives a CashTokens NFT receipt, and claims payouts or timeout refunds.

service.name: Market Service & Oracle
service.description: Provides the shared Parimutuel Pool covenant UTXO and oracle settlement data signature.

placePredictionStake.name: Place Parimutuel Prediction Stake
placePredictionStake.description: Locks stakeSatoshis into the shared Prediction Pool covenant and mints a CashTokens NFT position receipt.

predictor.name: Stake BCH on Outcome
predictor.description: Selects an outcome bucket and stakes satoshis to mint an NFT receipt.

service.name: Provide Pool Covenant UTXO
service.description: Supplies the active Prediction Pool UTXO and token category.

claimRoundPayout.name: Claim Parimutuel Round Payout
claimRoundPayout.description: Redeems a winning CashTokens NFT receipt against the resolved Prediction Pool using the oracle signature.

predictor.name: Redeem Winning NFT Receipt
predictor.description: Spends the winning NFT receipt to receive parimutuel payout satoshis.

service.name: Provide Resolved Pool & Oracle Proof
service.description: Supplies the resolved pool input and oracle signature.

reclaimExpiredStake.name: Reclaim Expired Stake (Timeout Refund)
reclaimExpiredStake.description: Trustlessly reclaims staked satoshis after refund sequence timeout if the oracle fails to resolve.

predictor.name: Reclaim Timed-Out Stake
predictor.description: Spends the NFT receipt after timeout to recover original staked satoshis.

placePredictionStakeTransaction.name: Prediction Stake Locked
placePredictionStakeTransaction.description: Locked $(<stakeSatoshis>) satoshis into Cashingularity Prediction Pool and minted NFT receipt.

claimRoundPayoutTransaction.name: Parimutuel Payout Claimed
claimRoundPayoutTransaction.description: Claimed $(<payoutSatoshis>) satoshis from resolved Cashingularity Prediction Pool.

reclaimExpiredStakeTransaction.name: Expired Prediction Stake Reclaimed
reclaimExpiredStakeTransaction.description: Reclaimed $(<stakeSatoshis>) satoshis after prediction round timeout.

poolStakeInput.name: Prediction Pool UTXO
poolStakeInput.description: Active Parimutuel Pool covenant UTXO holding the minting baton.

poolRefundInput.name: Timed-Out Prediction Pool UTXO
poolRefundInput.description: Prediction Pool UTXO after refund timeout blocks.

predictorReceiptInput.name: Predictor NFT Receipt Input
predictorReceiptInput.description: Spends the predictor's CashTokens NFT receipt to authorize payout or refund.

predictorChangeOutput.name: Predictor Change
predictorChangeOutput.description: Excess satoshis returned to the predictor.

predictorReceiveOutput.name: Predictor Receive Output
predictorReceiveOutput.description: Standard receive output for the predictor.

poolStakeContinuationOutput.name: Updated Prediction Pool Covenant
poolStakeContinuationOutput.description: Continues the Prediction Pool covenant with accumulated stakeSatoshis.

poolClaimContinuationOutput.name: Remaining Prediction Pool Covenant
poolClaimContinuationOutput.description: Continues the Prediction Pool covenant after deducting payoutSatoshis.

poolRefundContinuationOutput.name: Remaining Pool After Timeout Refund
poolRefundContinuationOutput.description: Continues the Prediction Pool covenant after returning timed-out stakeSatoshis.

predictorReceiptOutput.name: CashTokens NFT Position Receipt
predictorReceiptOutput.description: Mints a CashTokens NFT receipt recording the predictor's outcome bucket and stake.

predictorPayoutOutput.name: Parimutuel Winning Payout
predictorPayoutOutput.description: Pays $(<payoutSatoshis>) satoshis to the winning predictor.

predictorRefundOutput.name: Timeout Refund Output
predictorRefundOutput.description: Refunds $(<stakeSatoshis>) satoshis to the predictor after timeout.

predictionPoolContract.name: Prediction Pool Covenant
predictionPoolContract.description: Shared P2SH covenant locking parimutuel pool funds and verifying state transitions.

predictorReceiptLockingScript.name: Predictor Receipt & Payout Lock
predictorReceiptLockingScript.description: P2PKH locking script holding the predictor's CashTokens NFT receipt and receiving payouts.

scripts.poolCovenantRedeemBytecode: OP_INPUTINDEX OP_0 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE <dustLimit> OP_GREATERTHANOREQUAL

dustLimit.name: Dust Limit
dustLimit.description: Minimum satoshis required for a standard BCH output.

predictorKey.name: Predictor Signing Key
predictorKey.description: Private key derived by the predictor's XO engine for NFT receipts and payout claims.

stakeSatoshis.name: Stake Amount (Satoshis)
stakeSatoshis.description: Satoshis staked by the predictor into the selected outcome bucket.

payoutSatoshis.name: Winning Payout (Satoshis)
payoutSatoshis.description: Parimutuel payout satoshis claimed by a winning predictor.

poolSatoshis.name: Pool Balance (Satoshis)
poolSatoshis.description: Satoshis currently locked in the shared Prediction Pool UTXO.

expiryBlocks.name: Refund Timeout (Blocks)
expiryBlocks.description: Relative block age required before predictors can reclaim stakes without an oracle.

receiptTokenCategory.name: Receipt Token Category
receiptTokenCategory.description: 32-byte CashTokens category ID for prediction position receipts.

oracleSignature.name: Oracle Resolution Signature
oracleSignature.description: Schnorr signature from the market oracle certifying the winning outcome.

oraclePublicKey.name: Oracle Public Key
oraclePublicKey.description: 33-byte compressed public key of the market resolution oracle.
